text: {"lessons":["I tend to sell winners to lock in the satisfaction of a gain; I should judge whether to sell by the stock’s prospects and my overall plan, not just its price versus my cost.","Losses feel especially painful, so I may resist admitting a mistake. I should reassess losing positions honestly rather than hold them simply to get back to break-even.","I have traded each stock as a separate account, but my portfolio’s value depends on all positions together. I should consider diversification, cash, and total risk when deciding what to buy, sell, or hold."]}
